name: Backpropagation with Per-Splat Parallelization
definition: A parallelization scheme for the 3D Gaussian Splatting backward pass that maps threads to 2D splats instead of pixels to avoid atomic contention on gradient accumulation.
summary: Backpropagation with Per-Splat Parallelization is a backward pass scheme for 3D Gaussian Splatting that maps threads to splats to eliminate atomic contention, differing from pixel-mapped approaches by using intra-warp shuffling for state exchange.
